量化专业或辅修，须多元微积分、线性代数和通用编程；额外统计/经济学有帮助。: Quantitative major or minor with multivariable calculus, linear algebra and general programming. Additional statistics/economics is helpful.

需扎实线代、概率/随机方法、数值与编程。MCF尤其关注实分析/PDE、C++及金: Strong linear algebra, probability/stochastic methods, numerical methods and programming. MCF particularly emphasizes real analysis/PDEs, C++ and finance preparation.

须本科学位；经济/数学/科学背景可走Accelerated Track，商管背景: Bachelor’s degree required. Economics/mathematics/science graduates may enter the Accelerated Track; business/management graduates may enter the Business Track.
需管理类考试，可GMAT/GRE/TAGE MAGE。: Management test required: GMAT, GRE or TAGE MAGE.
